info.title: LanXu StoreOS API
info.description: 澜序 LanXu StoreOS V1 HTTP contract. Clients branch on error.code only. Source of truth: docs/product/lanxu-storeos-v1-master-spec.md §7.

post.summary: Password login → access token (org code + username)

get.summary: Current principal, store scope and effective permissions
Store rooms with state, visit, service progress (board §9.1)

post.summary: Open a visit into a room (state gate)
Move visit to another room (404 if destination missing)
§6.5 explainable recommendation: selected + excluded reasons + weights
Assign session to technician (rotation order enforced)
Skip an ACTIVE queue entry (audit required)
Compensation weight delta on a queue entry (append-only audit)
Manual reorder (force permission; approval may be required)
Create session (DRAFT; one active session per technician invariant)

get.summary: Store session list: technician/room/status/activeOnly/today filters (today = visit business_date)

post.summary: Reassign with new technician state gate
Cancel DRAFT/ASSIGNED booking (§5.3); releases assigned tech
Idempotent find-or-create the live bill for a visit (order.checkout)
Ring a line item — price/name snapshotted server-side (never client-supplied)
Append-only discount adjustment; cumulative over threshold ⇒ APPROVAL_REQUIRED
Freeze bill at PENDING_CHECKOUT (refuses running sessions); idempotent
Create payment (CASH only until Phase 13) — Idempotency-Key REQUIRED; attaches OPEN till
Server-side provider query → CAPTURED (client claims never count, §13.2); idempotent
HMAC-signed provider callback (public; signature = auth) — amount re-verified server-side, replay idempotent
Cashier confirm → CAPTURED + order paid/status/visit close/room ORDER_PAID in one tx; idempotent
Find-or-open the store till (one OPEN per store; order.checkout)
交班对账: expected = float + captured cash; records counted + variance (append-only audit)

get.summary: Active sellable goods with server list prices (order.read)
Active priced variants for the principal org (service.read)
Public kiosk heartbeat (X-Device-Code) → binding + server time; bumps last_seen_at

post.summary: Bind org→store→room (server cross-checks; one ACTIVE per room)
